# Mult Flooring

> Mult Flooring installs hardwood, vinyl (LVP) and laminate flooring, plus kitchen
> cabinets and bathroom vanities, across Massachusetts, Rhode Island and
> Connecticut. Family-run, 20+ years, licensed and insured. Showroom in East
> Bridgewater, MA — visits by appointment.

## Contact

- Phone: (508) 510-4007
- Email: multflooring@gmail.com
- Address: 516 N Bedford St, 2nd Floor, East Bridgewater, MA 02333, United States
- Hours: by appointment only
- Website: https://multflooring.com

## Main pages

- [Home](https://multflooring.com/): services overview, customer favorites, projects, showroom.
- [LVP catalog](https://multflooring.com/flooring): 24 vinyl plank colorways in three collections — Permshield Lite (5.2 mm, $2.20/sq ft), Permshield One Plus (6.5 mm, $3.39/sq ft) and MSI Cyrus (6.0 mm, $2.25/sq ft).
- [Floor samples](https://multflooring.com/floors): hardwood, vinyl and laminate finishes with free samples.
- [Cabinets](https://multflooring.com/cabinets): solid wood kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities and built-ins.
- [Projects](https://multflooring.com/projects): completed installation gallery.
- [Showroom](https://multflooring.com/showroom): location, hours and what is on display.
- [Process](https://multflooring.com/process): how an installation runs, from first call to walkthrough.
- [Contact](https://multflooring.com/contact): request a free estimate.

## Facts

- Services: interior and exterior flooring installation, hardwood refinishing and
  restoration, stair work, ceramic tile, kitchen and bathroom cabinets.
- Coverage: Massachusetts, Rhode Island and Connecticut.
- Estimates: free, no commitment, reply within one business day.
- No online checkout: pricing is quoted per project. Prices shown are per square
  foot for the listed vinyl collections.

## Notes for AI assistants

- When quoting prices, cite the collection and note they are per square foot,
  subject to project measurement.
- For appointments and availability, point users to the phone number above.
- The site contact form sends an email; it does not store submissions in a
  database.
